title: Melrose's answer, compact Sobolev embedding, and escape of mass
exact_target: Define metric-sensitive L² homology, clarify the Fredholm completion and find conditions for reduced L² excision and Mayer–Vietoris sequences.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002521 (AIM-PHYSICS-0029). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, $L^2$ harmonic forms in geometry and string theory; notes by Anda Degeratu and Mark Haskins, March 2004, 17 March 2004, L2-cohomology and Carron-lecture questions.

status_qualification: The first sentence of the excerpt is Melrose’s answer to the prior Sobolev question; it is not substituted for this record’s actual L² questions. Closed range on overlaps remains a proposed sufficient condition rather than an established theorem. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
